_doc: THE APP LINEUP FOR THE ~800-UNIT SELECT BUILD, and the file `tools/build.py` reads. `apps` is the launcher's grid order, `launcher` is the boot host, which hides itself, and `payload_only` names directories that are INSTALLED WITHOUT BEING TILES: they are compiled and copied, but they carry no `__init__` for the launcher's grid scan to find, because what another app reads out of them is the only reason they are there. 8 directories in all under `apps/`. The build refuses any directory this file does not name. Extracted by `scripts/export-source.py` from the repository's own `apps-roster.json`, which is the single source both exporters read -- the decision narrative behind each entry stays in the repository, and `excluded` here carries one compacted sentence per entry instead.

asset_profiles.note: Per-app payload pruning, and it governs `.gpa` deck files ONLY -- every module, icon, LUT and mask bank ships regardless, so nothing an app imports can go missing. A profile that kept zero decks would reset the badge at launch, which is why the exporter's `deck-assets-present` gate refuses one.

descriptions.flappy: POOLER.SQL, a tap-to-fly game about getting a query through the connection pool.
descriptions.glyph: Not a tile. The first-wake ceremony's decks, mask banks and player modules, installed at /system/apps/glyph because that is where the launcher reads them from; it has no __init__, so the grid never lists it.
descriptions.menu: The launcher. Boots the badge, draws the app grid, dims and opens the nametag when idle, and plays the first-wake ceremony on a cold start.
descriptions.nametag: The badge, worn. Full-screen artwork, marks and name, and the resting state the launcher returns to after 30 seconds of nothing.
descriptions.schedule: The conference agenda, fully offline. Day tabs, session detail, and an honest clock: it says when it cannot trust the time instead of guessing.
descriptions.settings: The utility tile: backlight, sleep, and the pairing and network status screens. With BadgeLink off it shows Not ready and everything else still works.
descriptions.setup: The wearable name badge and its editor: name, handle, marks and theme, edited on the badge with the QWERTY keyboard and saved to /state.
descriptions.snake: Snake, drawn at 160x120 and pixel-doubled, which is the look the games all landed on. A and C steer relative to travel, UP and DOWN are absolute, and the walls wrap.

glyph.reason: TILE RETIRED BY OWNER RULING 2026-08-28; the PAYLOAD STAYS because the launcher's first-wake ceremony reads its decks out of `/system/apps/glyph` and vendors none of its own (`launcher/host/build_menu.py` section IT VENDORS NO ASSET, and `launcher/menu/first_wake.py` GLYPH_ROOT). The dependency is SOFT -- `first_wake.play()` is total and a missing deck degrades to `reason=noasset` -- so dropping the directory outright would not have crashed anything, it would have silently turned the intro animation off. This keeps the ceremony and drops ~3.4 MB of decks no longer reachable now that the viewer is gone.

system_lib.note: Whether `/system/lib` ships at all. It does not: the network runtime is dark in this build. `main.py` keeps its guarded import either way, so the badge boots offline and prints `BADGELINK_NETWORK boot=offline error=ImportError`; `settings` is the only app that guards a `/system/lib` import and it degrades to its "Not ready" view.
